notes: Proxmox VE console: cluster VMs and containers with CPU/memory/disk/uptime, start / shutdown / stop / reboot with confirmation, console into REST and SSH to the host. New proxmox.guest_statu
Jobs automation: reliability pass across the app, engine and providers; system.notify now raises real toasts; and the complete Jobs guide (JOBS.md).
File Sharing: paste text from the web page onto the Tab5's Universal Clipboard (also saved to /.devos/clipboard.txt), with a read-back button.
Coder's Toolkit adds an IPv4 subnet calculator, a cron explainer (with the next runs) and a regex tester; JWT now verifies HS256/HS384/HS512 and shows claim dates, and Unix time converts bot
Restart and shutdown now ask first with the same confirm/cancel dialog as Settings > Power (Sym+Shift+R / Sym+Shift+Q).
Coder's Toolkit, Wake-on-LAN, power shortcuts
Fix OTA: the 300 ms interrupt watchdog fired during the flash write, resetting the Tab5 mid-update. It now has 1 s headroom.
Docs and comments: the system modifier is Sym, not Fn; theme persistence and audio documented as done. No functional change.
Fix OTA watchdog starvation by yielding more, v0.4.4
Restart and shutdown buttons in Power page, Sleep renamed, v0.4.3
One clipboard for every app: Sym+V pastes (text fields, Terminal, Editor); C in the Authenticator copies the code. Sym+S keyboard shortcuts, terminal bell, toasts, Docker SSH / web links, Se
Fixes updates over Wi-Fi stopping with a watchdog reset while the new image was written. A Tab5 on 0.3.3 or 0.4.0 still updates with its old installer: install 0.4.1 once by cable from this
Command palette: Sym+Space finds any app or command. Sym+I shows battery, memory, network and CPU over any app. Tapping Wi-Fi, battery or the clock in the top bar opens that part of Settings
The camera works again (WireGuard and 2FA QR codes).
Fixes 0.3.1 running out of memory: update checks, REST, SSH, the camera and new 2FA vaults work again. Known issue: the camera doesn't start (fixed in 0.3.3).
Updates over Wi-Fi install reliably; WireGuard no longer restarts the Tab5 on connect. Known issue: runs out of memory (fixed in 0.3.2).
File Sharing: add and remove files on the SD card from a browser (Settings > File Sharing). Known issue: the camera doesn't start (fixed in 0.3.3).
Screen no longer flashes during updates; Settings shows the exact build; install / rollback reported. Known issue: the camera doesn't start (fixed in 0.3.3).
New Cricket app: ESPNcricinfo live scores, results by date, scorecards.
ADS-B: OpenStreetMap map under the radar (M toggles it).
First public release.
